description_en: Delivers one-time password (OTP) message statuses to Alibaba Cloud, which calculates and monitors OTP conversion rates
description_zh: 将每一条消息ID(MessageId) 对应短信的接收情况反馈给阿里云国际短信平台
name: SmsConversion

parameters.help_en: The ID of the OTP message
parameters.name: message_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether customers replied to the OTP message. Valid values: true and false
parameters.help_zh: 如果您的用户回复了您发送的消息，则设置为 true。否则，设置为 false
parameters.name: delivered

parameters.help_en:
The time when the OTP message was delivered. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

If you leave the parameter empty, the current timestamp is specified by default.

If you specify the parameter, the timestamp must be greater than the message sending time and less than the current timestamp
parameters.help_zh:
触达发送目标的时间戳。必须是Unix时间戳，毫秒级别长整型。

如果不指定该字段：默认当前的时间戳。

如果指定该字段：该时间戳必须大于发送时间并且小于当前时间戳
parameters.name: conversion_time

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone number of the recipient. You must add the dialing code to the beginning of the mobile phone number.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158400.html
parameters.help_zh:
接收方号码。号码格式为：国际区号+号码。

电话代码详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158400.html
parameters.name: to

ResponseCode.description_en: The status code. If OK is returned, the request is successful. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/180674.html）
ResponseCode.description_zh: 状态码。返回OK代表请求成功，其他错误码，请参见错误码列表 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/180674.html)
ResponseCode.title_en: 状态码。返回OK代表请求成功，其他错误码，请参见错误码列表。
